title: How the internet’s favorite squirrel dad made the hottest camera app of 2026
brief: Derrick Downey Jr., a viral content creator known for his Instagram and TikTok videos featuring squirrels on his LA patio, launched DualShot Recorder, a camera app that hit #1 on the App Store's paid apps list within 12 hours of release. The app's rapid success demonstrates how creator audiences can translate to mainstream consumer adoption in mobile tools.
